data.name: Alhazar
data.gender_notes: Alhazar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Someone who conquers or overcomes obstacles, derived from the Arabic word 'al-hazir' meaning 'the present' or 'the conqueror' in a military context. The name Alhazar carries the meaning “The Conqueror” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Alhazar usually hope their child will grow to embody the conqueror and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents courage, determination, and the ability to overcome challenges and obstacles in one's life.
data.etymology: Alhazar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Conqueror.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alhazar total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
